subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should a Control UI project become durable Gateway session metadata, remain a user-defined group over existing sessions, or be kept separate from transcript branching and routed sends?
rationale: Current main supplies overlapping primitives, but source evidence cannot determine the intended permanent identity model or the safe semantics for copying selected transcript context and fanning one input across sessions.

options.title: First-class project metadata
options.body: Add additive project identity and branch lineage to the Gateway session model, then build tree navigation, selected-context copying, and routed sends on that canonical model.

options.title: Extend custom groups only
options.body: Treat projects as existing custom session groups and limit the feature to navigation and organization without cross-project transcript or fanout semantics.

options.title: Split the product tracks
options.body: Keep project organization, partial-transcript branching, and multi-target sends as separate canonical features with independently reviewed contracts.

recommendation.title: First-class project metadata
recommendation.body: Add additive project identity and branch lineage to the Gateway session model, then build tree navigation, selected-context copying, and routed sends on that canonical model.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session-thread implementation and prior issue review make this the strongest available routing candidate for the product-boundary decision.
